traces.command: Open the browser and search for Logitech MX Master 3S on both Amazon and Flipkart. Compare the final price, delivery date, seller rating, warranty, and return policy for each, then show me which one offers the better deal without adding anything to the cart.
traces.result:
I have compared the Logitech MX Master 3S on both Amazon and Flipkart:

1. Amazon:
   - Price: ₹8,475
   - Delivery Date: Tomorrow (Aug 7) / Saturday (Aug 8)
   - Seller & Rating: Clicktech Retail Private Ltd (Fulfilled by Amazon, trusted seller)
   - Warranty: 1 Year Warranty
   - Return Policy: 10 days Service Centre Replacement

2. Flipkart:
   - Price: ₹7,995 (can go down to ₹7,595 with bank offers)
   - Delivery Date: Thursday, Aug 13
   - Seller & Rating: RetailNet (4.3 / 5 rating, 10 years with Flipkart)
   - Warranty: 1 Year Limited Hardware Domestic Warranty
   - Return Policy: 7-day brand support

Verdict: Flipkart offers the better financial deal with a lower price of ₹7,995 (and ₹7,595 with bank offers), though Amazon offers significantly faster delivery if you need it right away. Neither item was added to the cart.
